system_choice: A self-contained Python interpreter for the jq language and its supplied conformance corpus.
commander_direction: A self-contained Python interpreter for the jq language and its supplied conformance corpus.

title: Numeric representation
description: The interpreter must represent jq numbers without third-party dependencies while preserving the corpus's required arithmetic and serialization behavior.
system_choice: Use a hybrid standard-library representation: preserve lexical literals where required and use float-compatible arithmetic semantics, with decimal or textual handling only where needed for corpus-compatible literal preservation.

title: Interpreter implementation shape
description: The implementation needs a stable separation between parsing, AST evaluation, builtins, and the executable wrapper.
system_choice: Use an executable root-level jq wrapper with adjacent Python modules for lexer, parser, evaluator, values, control flow, paths, and builtins.
